provenance: Scores copied from the measured runs recorded in the Gemini evaluation and faithfulness milestone reports. This rebuild did not call a provider, did not download reranker weights, and did not recompute these scores.

chunk_containment_1000_200.detail: 39 of 39 unique gold quotes. This is not retrieval quality.

chunk_containment_400_80.detail: 38 of 39 unique gold quotes. The quote that does not fit is the long clinic-linen gown paragraph. This is not retrieval quality.

keyword_recall_at_5.detail: top_k 5, chunk size 1000, overlap 200, 45 questions that have gold. Tied ranks follow chunk id, so a new ingest can move a tied hit across the cut.

deterministic_abstention.detail: All 8 unanswerable questions returned no keyword hits. Each one called answer_from_passages with an empty passage list. The generator was not called. This is not model abstention quality.

vector_recall_at_5.detail: Cosine distance, gemini-embedding-001, output dimensionality 1536, top_k 5.

rerank_recall_at_5.detail: Hybrid pool of 20, then cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 cut to 5.

citation_correctness.detail: Mean precision over 45 questions with gold. 4 of those abstained and scored 0. 8 of 8 unanswerable questions abstained. 8 of those reached the generator and 0 had empty hybrid retrieval.

deterministic_citation_form.detail: 53 of 53. A kept citation's chunk id was retrieved and its quote occurs in that passage, or the answer abstained with no citations.

latency_median_ms.detail: Median of 53 generator calls, linear interpolation on the sorted latencies.

latency_p95_ms.detail: P95 of 53 generator calls, linear interpolation on the sorted latencies.

prompt_tokens.detail: Sum of prompt tokens reported by the provider.

completion_tokens.detail: candidates_token_count plus thoughts_token_count only when that field is an int. The thoughts field was missing and was not added.

estimated_cost.detail: Input $0.30 per 1M tokens and output, including thinking tokens, $2.50 per 1M tokens, for gemini-3.5-flash-lite paid standard tier. Source: Gemini Developer API pricing, page last updated 2026-10-22 UTC, checked 23 Oct 2026, https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing. The free tier on that page is free of charge. 46827 / 1e6 * 0.30 + 5345 / 1e6 * 2.50 = 0.0274106. This is a published paid-tier price multiplied by the measured counts, not an invoice. The API response field estimated_cost stays null.

answer_faithfulness.detail: 53 of 53 stored answers were judged supported by gemini-3.5-flash-lite. This score is not ground truth. The judge can agree with a fluent unsupported answer.

notes: Faithfulness is not ground truth. The judge can agree with a fluent unsupported answer.
Deterministic abstention is a separate score from model abstention. It uses empty keyword retrieval and does not call the generator.
Chunk containment checks whether a gold quote fits inside a window. It is not retrieval quality.
Keyword ties follow chunk id, so a new ingest can move a tied hit across the top-5 cut.
The API field estimated_cost stays null. The cost above is the published price times the measured token counts.
